info.name: Cloud AI Commerce Platform
info.description:
API collection for commerce platform microservices.

## Auth tokens

1. **Auth Service → Login** — saves `accessToken` (JWT) and `refreshToken`.
2. **Refresh Token** — when the JWT expires, rotate with `{{refreshToken}}`.
3. **Product / Inventory / Order** — run **Login** first; Bearer token is sent automatically.

## Services (local defaults)

| Variable | Port | Notes |
|----------|------|-------|
| `authServiceBaseUrl` | 8080 | Login directly |
| `gatewayServiceBaseUrl` | 8088 | API gateway |
| `productServiceBaseUrl` | 8081 | Direct |
| `inventoryServiceBaseUrl` | 8082 | Direct |
| `orderServiceBaseUrl` | 8083 | Direct |
| `aiServiceBaseUrl` | 8084 | Direct (not via gateway) |

## Inventory product codes (seed)

`IPHONE17`, `RTX5090`, `PS6` — see `devops/db/init.sql`.

Re-import after collection updates.

request.description:
Run first (or to get a new session). On success, saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken`.

When the JWT expires (~1h), use **Refresh Token** instead of logging in again.

Sample users: `vincent` / `admin` / `tester` — password `123456`.

Run after **Login** when `accessToken` is expired or before it expires to rotate refresh token.

- Request body: `{ "refreshToken": "{{refreshToken}}" }` (no Bearer required).
- On 200: overwrites `accessToken` and `refreshToken` — always use the latest refresh value.
- Reusing an old refresh token returns 401.
Expected HTTP 401 with message `Invalid refresh token`.
Also sends Bearer if token exists. Expected HTTP 401.
Requires valid `accessToken` from **Login** or **Refresh Token**. Expected: `{ "valid": true, ... }`

item.name: AI Service
item.description:
Direct to AiService (**8084**). Not proxied by the gateway (gateway only routes Product/Inventory/Order). All `/api/v1/ai/*` business endpoints require a valid JWT — run **Auth Service → Login** first.

**Suggested flow:** `Chat` (saves `aiConversationId`) → `Chat (follow-up)` → `Get Conversation` → `Delete Conversation`.

`Ask` (RAG) needs product vectors synced from product events + a valid `OPENAI_API_KEY` configured on the service.

request.description: Public health check (no JWT). Expected: `{ "success": true, "data": { "status": "UP" } }`

exec: pm.test('conversationId saved for follow-up turns', function () {

request.description:
Starts a new conversation (no `conversationId` in body). Requires JWT.

On 200, saves the returned `conversationId` to the `aiConversationId` collection variable so **Chat (follow-up)**, **Get Conversation**, and **Delete Conversation** reuse it.
Run after **Chat**. Sends the saved `conversationId` so the service loads prior turns from Redis (conversation memory).
Requires JWT. Returns the full message history for the saved `aiConversationId`. Expected HTTP 404 if the conversation does not exist (or expired).
Requires JWT. Deletes the conversation history for the saved `aiConversationId` from Redis.

Requires JWT. Retrieval-Augmented Generation over the product catalog: embeds the question, searches the vector store (ChromaDB), and asks the LLM with retrieved product context.

**Prerequisites:** product vectors synced via Kafka product events + a valid `OPENAI_API_KEY` configured on ai-service. Returns 503 if the external AI dependency is unavailable.

Requires JWT. Personalized recommendations for the authenticated user via user-based collaborative filtering ("shoppers with similar history"), with a global-popularity fallback on cold start.

**Needs behaviour signals first:** place a few orders while logged in (Order Service → Create Order) — order/inventory events feed the signal store. Result is cached per user (cache-aside) and invalidated when new signals arrive. Empty `items` means no signals yet.

Requires JWT. Related-product recommendations seeded by a single product code (default `IPHONE17` via `inventoryProductCode`): products co-purchased by shoppers who also bought this one, excluding the seed. Falls back to popularity when there is no co-occurrence yet.
Strips Authorization to verify JWT enforcement. Expected HTTP 401.
